blockers: Recon rules prohibited executing the generation POST, settling a payment, or provisioning output.
A real paid run requires a funded Base or Tempo USDC wallet; none was supplied or usable during read-only recon.
trust_events: Would warn before spending: driftflight.com was registered on 2026-07-16, its terms predate registration, and searches found no independent footprint corroborating Driftflight Studio, Inc., its customers, or its testimonials.
notes: Primary product: pay-per-use text-to-image generation with style presets. Live manifest version 83838ab81588 prices sketch at $0.01/image, studio at $0.06/image, and gallery at $0.14/image; prepaid credits have the same rates with a $1 minimum. Human subscriptions are Hobby $5/month for 100 sketch generations, Studio $29/month for 750 sketch/studio generations, and Agency $119/month for 3,000 generations including gallery. Paid storefront renders have a commercial licence; failed renders are not billed, hosted URLs last 90 days, and documented service-defect refunds are available within 30 days. Concrete machine path: POST the generation request to https://agents.driftflight.com/v1/images/generate, receive a priced HTTP 402 challenge, sign and settle it through x402 using Base USDC or MPP using Tempo USDC, then retry the same request with payment proof. Pay-as-you-go requires no account, API key, CAPTCHA, KYC, verified email, or sales call. The optional three-image sketch trial does require a claimed agent identity and verified human email, but that gate is not required for the paid machine path.
